source_limitations: C1 also lists a three-pin connector and a no-plug field. Its linked primary product image was opened separately by the reviewer and visibly shows folding US flat blades, corroborating Type A.
C2 listing specifies the per-port maximum under shared use; the comparison follows those stated limits.
No belkin.com specification or manual was retrieved by Grok. No physical dimensions were verified.
Source capture timestamps and full task metrics are agent-reported; no native browser was used for this research.

recommendation.rationale: More shared power and an additional USB-A port for the same observed price as C2; costs USD 7.20 more than C3. Port pair assignment and physical size were not verified.
